{'text': '兩間獨立書店——留下書舍及田園書屋，前日（15日）遭國安警上門搜查並採取拘捕行動。據了解，留下書舍有三人、田園書屋有兩人被捕，被指涉嫌干犯《基本法》23條下的煽動罪。', 'translation': 'Two independent bookstores — Leave a Bookshop and Garden Bookstore — were raided and arrests were carried out by national security police the day before yesterday (the 15th). It is understood that three people from Leave a Bookshop and two people from Garden Bookstore were arrested on suspicion of committing the offence of sedition under Article 23 of the Basic Law.'}

{'text': '政府發稿指，警方國安處接獲海關轉介，經調查後於旺角兩間書店拘捕五人，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第二十四條「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖的作為」罪，並檢走一批書籍。', 'translation': 'According to a government press release, the National Security Department of the police received a referral from the Customs and Excise Department, and after investigation arrested five people at two bookstores in Mong Kok on suspicion of violating Section 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, which criminalises acts with seditious intent committed with a seditious intent. A batch of books was also seized.'}
